paragraphs: R' Yehoshua son of R' Tanhum son of R' Hiyya of Kefar Agon. See the entry R' Yose.[^1]

notes.text: The whole three-generation patronymic and trailing Kefar Agon designation remain in source order. ערך directs to R' Yose, without identity binding or evaluation of the destination. All four title components are abbreviated and remain R'.
